description: This file defines a CartProvider class that manages shopping cart state, including adding/removing items, updating quantities, calculating totals, and placing orders, for a Flutter-based mobile application.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: Manages the shopping cart state, including items, order placement, and notification of changes to the UI.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified book to the cart with an optional quantity, updating existing entries if present.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes a book from the cart based on its ID.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific book in the cart, removing it if quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Asynchronously places an order using a mock service, resets the cart upon success, and returns an order ID.
